cues.en: DREW: Do people ever get kicked off of the network for bad behavior?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：当他们开始以此谋取私利时，这是不被允许的，
cues.en: ROBERTO: When they start making business with profit, for himself, we don't permit that,

cues.zh: 我们会把他们封禁出网。
cues.en: we ban them from the network.

cues.zh: 我们管这叫“bañamos”（封禁）。
cues.en: That's how we say, "bañamos."

cues.zh: 我们会封掉他。
cues.en: We ban him.

cues.zh: 还有在游戏里作弊的。
cues.en: For cheating in games.

cues.zh: 有两三个人专门负责游戏管理。
cues.en: There's two or three people that are the admins of games.

cues.zh: 有专门针对 Call of Duty 的，也有针对 World of Warcraft 的。
cues.en: There's one for Call of Duty, there's another one for World of Warcraft.

cues.zh: 他们还有……算不上正式员工，但有人帮他们抓那些
cues.en: And they have, not employees, but they have people that help them to detect people that

cues.zh: 在游戏里开挂的人。
cues.en: is cheating in the game.

cues.zh: 我们很反感作弊，因为我们想让大家公平竞争。
cues.en: We don't like that because we are trying to make everybody even.

cues.zh: 所以，要是抓到你开挂，就把你封号。
cues.en: So, if we caught you cheating, we ban you from the game.

cues.zh: 不是永久封禁，但可能过一两个月你才能玩。
cues.en: Not forever, but maybe in a month or two, you can play.

cues.zh: 如果你屡教不改，我们就彻底封了你，然后……
cues.en: If you keep doing that, and doing that, we just ban you and...

cues.zh: 我也不知道，去别的网吧玩吧，随便了。
cues.en: I don't know, go to other network, I don't know.

cues.zh: 反正就这一个网。
cues.en: It's the only one.

cues.zh: DREW：大家平时是怎么发现新游戏的？
cues.en: DREW: How do people find out about new games to play?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：基本上是……“某个人”，任何能连上好网的人下载了
cues.en: ROBERTO: Mostly we... "somebody," anybody who has access to the internet--good internet--downloads

cues.zh: 一款游戏，然后神奇地就传到我们网内了，大家一起共享。
cues.en: one game and then magically it just comes to the network, and share it.

cues.zh: 就像在说，“来玩这个游戏吧，挺好的。
cues.en: It'll be like, "let's play this game, it's good.

cues.zh: 我们可以在局域网里玩”，然后大家都能玩。
cues.en: We can play on the local network" and everybody could play that.

cues.zh: 我们就这样一台机器、一台机器地复制过去。
cues.en: And we just copy things, from machine, to machine, to machine, to machine.

cues.zh: 我们不会去下载一个游戏，因为在这里下载一个游戏，一个GB，
cues.en: We don't just go and download one game because downloading one game, here, one gigabyte,

cues.zh: 下载要花很长时间。
cues.en: long time downloading that.

cues.zh: DREW VO：为了看看网络的实际运行，我们沿着一条以太网线走了一遍
cues.en: DREW VO: To see the network in action, we walked the length of one of the ethernet cables

cues.zh: 这条线从Jesus家引出来。
cues.en: leading from Jesus’ home.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：你能看到蓝色线缆通向那栋房子。
cues.en: ROBERTO: You can see the blue cable goes down to that house.

cues.zh: 它们都连在一起，都接入了网络。
cues.en: They're all connected, they're all connected to the network.

cues.zh: 从那栋房子开始，信号继续穿过所有街道。
cues.en: And from that house, the signal keeps going through all the streets.

cues.zh: DREW VO：线缆到头的地方，Jesus节点的覆盖范围也就到头了。
cues.en: DREW VO: When the cable terminated, so did the reach of Jesus’ node.

cues.zh: 但当然，还有更多节点，它们变成更多交换机，把更多人
cues.en: But of course, there are more nodes, which turn into more switches, that connect more

cues.zh: 接入SNET，网络就这样不断扩大。
cues.en: people to SNET, and the network grows.

cues.zh: 据估计，SNET 服务了超过两万人。
cues.en: By some estimates, SNET serves over 20,000 people.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：看到那儿了吗？
cues.en: ROBERTO: See there?

cues.zh: 我们刚才往这边走，警察就在那儿把我们拦下了。
cues.en: We were walking over here and police stopped us right there.

cues.zh: 特别搞笑。
cues.en: It was very funny.

cues.zh: 他那片网络的网线就到这里为止。
cues.en: The cables from his network end here.

cues.zh: 从这里往后，网络就由其他人管了。
cues.en: From this point further, other people control the network.

cues.zh: DREW：但还是同一个网络？
cues.en: DREW: But it's the same network?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：是同一个网络。
cues.en: ROBERTO: It's the same network.

cues.zh: DREW 旁白：绰号“Butty”的 Dariel 提供了其中一台交换机。
cues.en: DREW VO: Dariel, alias "Butty," provides one of these switches.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：那就是交换机。
cues.en: ROBERTO: That's the switch.

cues.zh: 所有的网线都连到那上面。
cues.en: All the cables, they connect there.

cues.zh: DREW 旁白：Butty 也是个铁杆玩家。
cues.en: DREW VO: Butty is also an avid gamer.

cues.zh: 痴迷到尽管只有一台 PC，却对最新的《塞尔达》了如指掌。
cues.en: So avid that he was up on the latest Zelda, despite only owning a PC.

cues.zh: 这里不是没有游戏主机，但价格极其昂贵，所以 PC 基本占了主导。
cues.en: Game consoles are not unknown here, but are extremely expensive, so the PC tends to rule.

cues.zh: 正如 Roberto 所说，《魔兽世界》非常受欢迎。考虑到 SNET
cues.en: As Roberto said, World of Warcraft is quite popular. Impressive considering SNET is, again,

cues.zh: 根本没有连接到互联网，这确实令人惊叹。
cues.en: not connected to the Internet.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：然后……他赢了。
cues.en: ROBERTO: And... he won.

cues.zh: DREW VO：Henetica除了为游戏和通信提供运行的服务器，
cues.en: DREW VO: Henetica, in addition to providing servers for games and communication to run on,

cues.zh: 还有一个前端，相当于一个门户。
cues.en: also has a front end that acts as a sort of portal.

cues.zh: 点击列表里的任何一项，就会带你进入一个大厅，你可以在那儿等其他人
cues.en: Clicking on anything in this list will bring you to a lobby where you can wait for others

cues.zh: 然后启动游戏。
cues.en: before launching the game.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：房间满员后，游戏就开始了。
cues.en: ROBERTO: And when the room is full, the game starts.

cues.zh: DREW VO：但这不仅仅是游戏。
cues.en: DREW VO: But it’s more than just games.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：我们有个足球页面，你可以去看看比赛的最新消息
cues.en: ROBERTO: We have a football page where you can go and see the latest news from games

cues.zh: 和球员动态。
cues.en: and players.

cues.zh: 还有个聊天室，赛后可以在那儿讨论。
cues.en: A chat room, also, where you can discuss after a game.

cues.zh: DREW：什么是“Steam SNET”？
cues.en: DREW: What is "Steam SNET?"

cues.zh: ROBERTO：他们正努力让玩家能在那页面上玩足球游戏——FIFA、实况足球这些
cues.en: ROBERTO: They are working to be able to play football--FIFA, Pro Evolution, those games--in

cues.zh: 游戏。
cues.en: that page.

cues.zh: 这就像是SNET的Facebook。古巴版Facebook。
cues.en: This is like Facebook for SNET. Cuban Facebook.

cues.zh: DREW VO：甚至还有个类似Craigslist的地方，你可以在那儿买到足够的网络设备
cues.en: DREW VO: There's even a Craigslist of sorts, where you can buy enough networking equipment

cues.zh: 来搭建自己的节点。
cues.en: to make your own node.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：那些是 NanoStation、交换机，还有用来联网的设备。
cues.en: ROBERTO: Those are nanostations and switch and things to connect to the net.

cues.zh: DREW 旁白：Jesus 和 Butty 兴奋地聊了好几分钟 CAT6 双绞线。
cues.en: DREW VO: Jesus and Butty spent a few minutes geeking out over CAT6 cable.

cues.zh: 但这个网站上也列出了一些游戏配件。
cues.en: But the site also lists gaming accessories.

cues.zh: DREW：买这种东西只能通过这种方式吗？
cues.en: DREW: Is that the only way to buy things like that?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：不，你也可以去实体店，但店里卖得非常贵，而且在店里
cues.en: ROBERTO: No, you can go to a store, but the stores are very expensive, and it's weird

cues.zh: 看到这些东西挺少见的。
cues.en: to see those things in the stores.

cues.zh: 这里的数码店卖的是很小的 Logitech 鼠标。
cues.en: The electronic stores here, they sell little Logitech mouse.

cues.zh: 原本是白色的，后来发黄了……质量很差，体验很糟糕。
cues.en: They're white, they get yellow, and.. bad. It's bad.

cues.zh: DREW 旁白：作为美国人，我们不能在国营商店买任何东西，但
cues.en: DREW VO: As Americans we weren’t allowed to buy anything from state-run stores, but

cues.zh: 我们还是走进去看了一眼。
cues.en: we walked inside one to see what it was like.

cues.zh: 果不其然，最基础的廉价键盘（带30天保修）
cues.en: Sure enough, your standard barebones keyboard (with 30-day guarantee) shared shelf space

cues.zh: 在这家数码店里，居然和卷发器、烤箱摆在同一个货架上。
cues.en: in this electronics store with hair curlers and ovens.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：在这个页面上你什么都能买到。
cues.en: ROBERTO: You can buy anything in this page.

cues.zh: 车子，或者别的任何东西。
cues.en: A car, whatever.

cues.zh: DREW VO：当然，这也包括游戏主机，不过因为它们标的大多都是
cues.en: DREW VO: This extends, of course, to game consoles, which, since most were listed at

cues.zh: 美国零售价左右，对大多数古巴人来说简直贵得离谱。
cues.en: roughly US retail price, are prohibitively expensive for most Cubans.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：只要是你想卖的，都可以挂在这里。
cues.en: ROBERTO: You can just put here whatever you want to sell.

cues.zh: 比如房子什么的。
cues.en: A place or whatever.

cues.zh: 你发张照片、标上价格、写几句描述，再留下你的电话号码就行。
cues.en: You post a picture, the price, comments about the item, and your phone number.

cues.zh: DREW：那些人的游戏都是从哪儿搞来的？
cues.en: DREW: Where do those people get those games?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：有人出国，就会顺便买些游戏，因为在国外便宜。
cues.en: ROBERTO: Somebody travels to another country, they buy games, because they're cheap.

cues.zh: 比如在你们国家，买个游戏肯定很便宜。
cues.en: For example in your country, they must be cheap, buying a game.

cues.zh: 然后他们带回这里卖掉什么的。
cues.en: And they bring it here and they sell it and whatever.

cues.zh: DREW：就这样带进国内卖，真的没问题吗？
cues.en: DREW: Is it okay to bring it into the country like that and sell it?

cues.zh: ROBERTO：他们根本不在乎。
cues.en: ROBERTO: They really don't care.

cues.zh: 你可以把游戏带过来，说是给自己玩的，就自己玩游戏，你直接去
cues.en: You can bring the game and say that it's for you, for your own gaming, and you just go

cues.zh: 那个页面发帖说“我想卖掉我所有的游戏。”
cues.en: to that page and you post "I wanna sell all my games."

cues.zh: 没事的，没人在意。
cues.en: And it's okay, nobody cares.

cues.zh: DREW：但你是在卖它赚钱。
cues.en: DREW: But you're selling it for profit.

cues.zh: ROBERTO：是啊，严格来说这不算重罪。
cues.en: ROBERTO: Yeah, it's not really a felony, per se.

cues.zh: 但肯定是不合法的。
cues.en: But it must be illegal.

cues.zh: 只是他们根本不管。
cues.en: But they just don't care.

cues.zh: DREW VO：我反复问过能不能把Roberto和Jesus告诉我们的都放进去，他们
cues.en: DREW VO: I asked repeatedly if I could include everything Roberto and Jesus told us, and

cues.zh: 说可以。
cues.en: they said yes.

cues.zh: 看来政府乐意让哈瓦那人民运营SNET，只要
cues.en: It seems the government is content to let the people of Havana operate SNET as long

cues.zh: 不滥用特权就行。
cues.en: as it doesn’t abuse its privileges.

cues.zh: 这就是网络连接的“纸袋装酒”。
cues.en: The “alcohol in a paper bag” of connectivity.

cues.zh: 这本身就很有意思，但真正让我惊讶的是，这一切都是本土自建的
cues.en: This is fascinating in its own right, but what really amazed me is that it’s all home-grown

cues.zh: 而且免费维护。
cues.en: and maintained free of charge.

cues.zh: 像Jesus和Butty这样的人付出努力去连接人们，无论是比喻意义上还是字面意义上，
cues.en: People like Jesus and Butty put in the work to connect people, figuratively and literally,

cues.zh: 因为他们懂得沟通、合作的价值，也懂得一起玩耍
cues.en: because they know the value of communication, of cooperation, and what it means to play

cues.zh: 意味着什么。
cues.en: together.

cues.zh: 纯粹为了人民的福祉而这样做，确实是开创性的壮举。
cues.en: Doing so purely for the good of the people is something truly revolutionary.
